Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: synthetic-canary-eu PROBE_FAILURE fired for eu-canary-05 (probe-id: 7f9a3c) - https://pd.example/INC12345 - auto-escalation: page to SRE Oncall
PagerDuty: INC12345 created and pages sent to rotation (ack deadline: 5m)
SRE Oncall (EU): ack - looking
Maria Ops: ack from me too. seeing repeated pages?
Alex K: +1 multiple identical pages in PD. looks like prober TTL loop - logs show repeated probe_id 7f9a3c every 10s
Jonah R: can you paste the prober log tail?
Alex K: ```
2026-03-15T09:10:00Z prober[eu-canary-05] probe_id=7f9a3c status=timeout ttl=30s
2026-03-15T09:10:10Z prober[eu-canary-05] probe_id=7f9a3c schedule=retry reason=ttl_expired
2026-03-15T09:10:20Z prober[eu-canary-05] probe_id=7f9a3c status=timeout ttl=30s
```
SRE Oncall (EU): hmm repeated schedule=retry with same probe_id - we expect jitter/random backoff. This smells like the jitter seed bug from last month.
Emily P: customer impact? any user-facing errors?
Maria Ops: checking metrics — small uptick in 502s for hosted inference in eu-west-1 around 09:09-09:13, ~0.6% above baseline. A few retries but no customer reports yet.
SRE Oncall (EU): mitigation plan: 1) silence duplicate PD pages for this incident (manual suppress) 2) disable eu-canary-05 prober to stop fanout 3) push hotfix to prober config to re-enable random_jitter=true 4) scale probe-runner to absorb backlog
Jonah R: I'll take step 2 and 4. Maria, can you suppress PD noise?
Maria Ops: suppressing duplicate alerts in PD now (silence window 30m). PD note: silenced for eu-canary-05.
Alex K: disabling eu-canary-05 prober: `kubectl scale deployment eu-canary-05-prober --replicas=0 -n synthetic` -> done.
Jonah R: bumping probe-runner CPU -> `k scale dr-probe-runner --namespace=platform --cpu=2000m` -> change applied, replicas 4->6.
SRE Oncall (EU): good. patch: changing prober config to enable jitter and increase timeout margin. applying now.
Platform Bot: CI job started: synthetic/prober/config-hotfix #452 -> running tests
Alex K: quick sanity check on API frontends: `nginx -s status` shows spike but backend healthy, 502s came from short-lived upstream timeouts during probe fanout
Emily P: customers: PD ticket updated — no major customer impact, monitoring continuous. I'll draft an incident note for support to notify any customers who opened tickets.
SRE Oncall (EU): PD incident INC12345 acknowledged by SRE Oncall (EU) and Maria Ops. marking status: mitigation_in_progress.
Platform Bot: CI job passed -> deploying hotfix to prober config (canary rollout 10%)
Jonah R: hotfix rolled to 10% -> no new timeouts in logs at 09:14. increasing to 100%
Alex K: prober replicas scaled back up and hotfix active. prober logs now show random_jitter seed applied and distinct probe_ids per retry. sample: `probe_id=8b2d4f jitter_ms=345 status=ok`
SRE Oncall (EU): lifting PD silence in 5m if stable. last 10m 502 rate back to baseline.
Maria Ops: PD silence removed. INC12345 set to resolved_prelim with note: root cause suspected prober jitter seed bug causing TTL-based retry storm and duplicate PD pages. follow-up: postmortem and permanent fix tracked in PLAT-789.
Emily P: thanks all. I'll create a short customer-facing blurb in support channel: "intermittent canary-induced 502s in EU, mitigated, no confirmed customer impact"
Jonah R: leave a note to improve prober observability: add unique_request_id to every probe and PD payload so duplicates easier to suppress next time (task created: PLAT-790).
SRE Oncall (EU): handing off to daytime oncall @Alex K for follow-up. I'll add detailed notes in INC12345 and close pager.
Incident Bot: INC12345 closed by SRE Oncall (EU) at 2026-03-15T09:18:40Z. Postmortem assigned: PLAT-789. :white_check_mark:
